verdict.rationale: Intel's product page names a dedicated Intel Xe Media Engine that supports playing, streaming and editing at once without hurting game graphics, and pitches Arc graphics for long edits and heavy exports. That confirms on-chip media hardware exists, but none of the evidence specifies codecs or encode/decode capabilities. Missing for 10: documented AV1 encode/decode, HEVC encode/decode, ProRes-class codec support, codec/resolution spec tables, and independent or hands-on corroboration of media-engine performance.
